Name: Civic Office
Description: The Capital's first office: permits, taxes and a few clerks doing research on the side.

Name: Spaceport
Planets: Terran / Arid / Ice / Volcanic / Barren / Gas Giant / Asteroid
Description: Orbital launch facility. Enables ship construction and interplanetary trade routes.

Name: Housing Authority
Description: +10% housing in this City (the City and its districts).

Name: Financial District
Description: +10% credits in this City (the City and its districts).

Name: Research Directorate
Description: +10% Science in this City (the City and its districts).

Name: Logistics Center
Description: +10% raw and processed output in this City, and Warehouse-sized storage.

Name: Planetary Command
Description: +10% energy in this City (the City and its districts).

Name: Lunar Spaceport
Description: Launch complex in low lunar gravity. The final rocket is prepared here. Moon Capital only.

Name: Surface Quarry
Description: A small open pit: half a Mine for half the workers and power.

Name: Fuel Depot
Description: +300 Fuel storage.

Name: Mine
Description: Extracts the raw resources under the district.

Name: Regolith Extractor
Description: Scrapes and sifts the lunar soil for the Moon's mineral.

Name: Goods Factory
Description: Turns raw resources into Consumer Goods. Rarer raws yield more.

Name: Warehouse
Description: Storage halls for raw resources and processed goods. Raises storage limits.

Name: Regolith Silo
Description: Sealed bins that keep lunar materials out of the dust.

Name: Compact Fuel Workshop
Description: A small first Fuel line: 8 Ferrite into 2 Fuel.

Name: Rare Element Forge
Description: Extracts Rare Elements from raw resources. Rarer raws yield more.

Name: Deep Drill
Description: Reaches deeper deposits for more raw resources.

Name: Advanced Excavator
Description: Heavy surface excavation: more raw output per slot than a Mine.

Name: Ore Sorting Workshop
Description: Dense Goods processing: three Goods Factories' worth in two slots.

Name: Regolith Goods Plant
Description: Processes lunar regolith into Goods — Moonstone stretches further (×1.75).

Name: Fuel Refinery
Description: Turns raw resources into Fuel Rods. Rarer raws yield more.

Name: Mantle Cracker
Description: Cracks the mantle open. Burns Fuel Rods.

Name: Solar Array
Description: Clean energy from sunlight. +30% on a desert.

Name: Lunar Solar Array
Description: No air, no clouds: panels on the Moon catch the full sun.

Name: Wind Turbine
Description: Harvests wind. Must stand on a windy region (pale streaks on the map); +30% output there.

Name: Shallow Geothermal Well
Description: A small first well on hot ground. Must stand on a volcanic field or a geothermal rift.

Name: Solar Matrix
Description: High-efficiency solar field. +30% on a desert.

Name: Tidal Generator
Description: Turns the tides into energy. Must stand on a sea coast; +20% output there.

Name: Geothermal Plant
Description: Taps the heat below. Must stand on a volcanic field or a geothermal rift (+30% / +40%).

Name: Ridge Turbine
Description: Tall turbines on windy ground: four Wind Turbines' worth in two slots. Must stand on a windy region; best on mountains.

Name: Fusion Reactor
Description: Large, steady power. Burns Fuel Rods.

Name: Antimatter Plant
Description: Enormous output for a heavy Fuel Rod appetite.

Name: Field Observatory
Description: A small hilltop station. Must stand on a mountain.

Name: Research Lab
Description: Basic research. Produces science.

Name: Lunar Research Outpost
Description: A small lab that studies the Moon on the spot.

Name: Research Institute
Description: Larger research programmes.

Name: Mountain Observatory
Description: Thin, clear air above the clouds. Must stand on a mountain.

Name: Lunar Sample Lab
Description: Studies lunar samples on site. Moon only.

Name: Particle Accelerator
Description: Cutting-edge physics. Consumes Rare Elements.

Name: Quantum Lab
Description: Quantum research. Consumes Rare Elements.

Name: Orbital Cargo Bay
Description: The first module of a new station: sealed holds for Goods and Fuel waiting for launch.

Name: Zero-G Lab
Description: Orbital research. Produces science.

Name: Orbital Mirrors
Description: +15% energy across the planet below.

Name: Offworld Market
Description: Orbital trade. Produces credits.

Name: Orbital Logistics
Description: +20% raw extraction and processed output on the planet below. Adds orbital warehouses.

Name: Orbital Shipyard
Description: Builds and sells hulls. Produces credits, consumes Fuel Rods.

Name: Low-rise Housing
Description: Simple homes that need no power: the housing you build when the grid is short.

Name: Habitat Block
Description: Basic housing. Raises the planet's max population.

Name: Pressurised Habitat
Description: Buried, pressurised living quarters for the first lunar settlers.

Name: Apartment Towers
Description: Dense housing for a growing city.

Name: Seaside Villas
Description: Sought-after homes by the sea. Must stand on a sea coast.

Name: Coastal Apartments
Description: Dense homes on the shore — more housing than Seaside Villas, more power. Must stand on a sea coast.

Name: Modular Moon Habitat
Description: Pressurised modules built from regolith. Moon only.

Name: Luxury Spires
Description: High-end living. Needs a steady supply of Consumer Goods.

Name: Arcology
Description: A self-contained city in a single structure. Consumes Consumer Goods.

Name: Market
Description: Local commerce. Produces credits.

Name: Lunar Trade Post
Description: Swaps supplies between settlers and incoming freighters.

Name: Local Trade Center
Description: A larger market without upkeep: more credits per slot than two Markets, at a higher price.

Name: Bazaar
Description: Sells Consumer Goods to the people — far more credits than a plain Market.

Name: Trade Hub
Description: Regional trade. Produces more credits.

Name: Harbor Market
Description: Sea trade on the waterfront. Must stand on a sea coast.

Name: Lunar Supply Market
Description: Supplies the lunar settlements. Moon only.

Name: Commodity Exchange
Description: Sells Consumer Goods at a premium.

Name: Interstellar Bank
Description: Finance on a planetary scale. Consumes Consumer Goods.
